name: Midnight Roots | 200mg RSO Full Moon Chocolate | Cinnamon Roll
description:
Indulge in the warm, comforting embrace of our Cinnamon Roll Full Moon, where the sweet, spiced nostalgia of a fresh-baked cinnamon roll meets the creamy decadence of a milk chocolate base. Infused with Rick Simpson Oil (RSO), this flavor delivers not only impeccable taste but also the full-spectrum medicinal benefits that set Midnight Roots apart.

Crafted with care and inspired by our shared dedication to wellness, community, and quality, this Full Moon flavor is the perfect fusion of indulgence and intention. Whether you're here for the experience, the benefits, or both, the Cinnamon Roll Full Moon is a testament to our mission: elevating cannabis and the people who enjoy it.
